thread:
emily.marketing: Quick heads up — we're prepping customer-facing comms for the degraded embeddings incident. Need: final status page copy, recommended send timing for email + in-product banner, and segmentation guidance. Can y'all weigh in? :wave:

liam.sre: Current state: partial degradation affecting embedding lookups for ~12% of requests. Mitigation in progress, traffic is being routed to fallback model. No full RCA yet. ETA unknown; working on fix.

jackie.ops: Recommend two-phase approach: 1) immediate status entry + in-product banner calling out degraded embeddings, 2) targeted email to affected customers ~30–60m after stabilization, 3) broader note once fixed and postmortem ready. Timezones: stagger email for EU at +2h if we publish now.

emily.marketing: Thanks — can you drop draft copy for status page + a suggested email subject/body? I can make tone edits. Prefer short, plain-language phrasing.

liam.sre: Draft statuspage (brief):
```
Status: Degraded — Embeddings latency/errors
We are currently seeing reduced availability for embeddings for a subset of requests. Traffic has been routed to a fallback model to limit impact. Our engineers are investigating.
Affected: Some embeddings requests may return lower-quality results or errors.
Updated: ongoing
```

liam.sre: For email subject options: "Temporary issue affecting embeddings" or "We're working on an embeddings issue affecting some requests"

nisha.product: Suggest we add a short workaround for customers who depend on embeddings for search ranking: "If you rely on embeddings for production ranking, temporarily pin to model X_v1 or enable synchronous fallback." Keep it actionable and avoid jargon.

emily.marketing: Proposed marketing-friendly statuspage copy (shorter, customer-facing):
```
We’re experiencing issues with our embeddings service that may cause delayed or lower-quality results for some operations. We’ve put an automatic fallback in place to reduce impact. Our engineers are investigating and we’ll update here as we learn more.
```

emily.marketing: Email snippet (targeted):
Subject: "Notice: temporary impact on embeddings affecting some requests"
Body excerpt: "Hi — you may see degraded results from our embeddings service for a subset of requests. We’ve applied a fallback and are actively working on a fix. We’ll follow up when service is restored and share any recommended actions. If this affects production workflows, reply and we’ll prioritize support."

jackie.ops: +1 to that tone. Ops note: avoid promising a timeline. Use "working on a fix" not "fixing in X minutes". For enterprise customers with SLA ties, prepare a short, personalised outreach template.

deploy-bot: [deploy status] canary-rollout-emb-fallback started at 1987654350 — 18/24 nodes updated.

liam.sre: Also add a short line for status page about scope: "This affects a subset of embeddings requests; models for text generation are unaffected." Reduces confusion.

emily.marketing: Good call. Request: can someone confirm whether we should: A) publish status page + banner now and delay email, or B) publish all at once? I lean A (announce public status now, email only to affected after we confirm scope)

jackie.ops: I agree A. Immediate public transparency helps reduce inbound noise. Targeted email after we confirm customer impact (should be automated from incident tooling if we can tag affected accounts).

nisha.product: If possible, include a short FAQ item on the status page: "What to do now" with the workaround and contact link. Marketing can reuse that copy for email.

emily.marketing: Action items: 1) liam to post the short statuspage copy + scope line (now). 2) jackie to coordinate segmentation for email (30–60m after stabilization). 3) nisha to write the FAQ/workaround blurb. 4) emily to finalize tone and send targeted email. I'll set a 11:15 PST quick sync to sign off. :calendar:

liam.sre: Posting status now. Will update with canary progress and any ETA changes.

jackie.ops: I’ll start segmenting customers and flag enterprise SKUs for manual outreach.

emily.marketing: Thanks team — keep thread updated. If anyone adds copy, paste here so I can Tweak and publish. :thumbsup:
